description: This source file defines Swagger API documentation classes for loan charges endpoints in the Apache Fineract project. It includes data models for requests and responses related to loan charge management, such as retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting charges.

classes.name: LoanChargesApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Container for Swagger API models related to loan charges, including response structures for various operations.

classes.name: GetLoansLoanIdChargesChargeIdResponse
classes.description: Response model for retrieving a specific loan charge detail.

classes.name: GetLoanChargeTimeType
classes.description: Represents the type of charge timing (e.g., disbursement).

classes.name: GetLoanChargeCalculationType
classes.description: Represents the calculation type of the charge (e.g., flat).

classes.name: GetLoanChargeCurrency
classes.description: Details about the currency used for a charge.

classes.name: GetLoansLoanIdChargesTemplateResponse
classes.description: Response model for the template data used when creating or editing charges.

classes.name: GetLoanChargeTemplateChargeOptions
classes.description: Options for a charge template, including applicable charge timing and application.

classes.name: GetLoanChargeTemplateChargeTimeType
classes.description: Charge time type options in the template.

classes.name: GetLoanChargeTemplateChargeAppliesTo
classes.description: Indicates what the charge applies to in the template.

classes.name: PostLoansLoanIdChargesRequest
classes.description: Request payload for creating a new loan charge.

classes.name: PostLoansLoanIdChargesResponse
classes.description: Response after creating a loan charge, including resource identifiers.

classes.name: PutLoansLoanIdChargesChargeIdRequest
classes.description: Request payload for updating a specific loan charge.

classes.name: PutLoansLoanIdChargesChargeIdResponse
classes.description: Response after updating a loan charge.

classes.name: PostLoansLoanIdChargesChargeIdRequest
classes.description: Request payload for adding an extra charge to a loan.

classes.name: PostLoansLoanIdChargesChargeIdResponse
classes.description: Response after adding a charge with details like resource IDs.

classes.name: PostLoansLoanIdChargesChargeIdChanges
classes.description: Details of changes made to a charge, including transaction details.

classes.name: DeleteLoansLoanIdChargesChargeIdResponse
classes.description: Response for deleting a loan charge.
